tool_schemas.name: get_income_statements
tool_schemas.description: Returns normalized income statement data for the requested equity ticker for the specified reporting period (annual, quarterly, or ttm), up to the most recent `limit` statements (default 4). Results are returned as a simple list ordered from most recent to oldest; use `limit` to page by requesting fewer/more recent statements. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `ticker`/`period` are missing or invalid or `limit` < 1, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved to a supported public company or no income statements exist for that period, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your credentials are missing/invalid or you exceed your plan’s request limits.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

period.description: Reporting period for the income statement.

limit.description: Number of income statements to return (default: 4).

tool_schemas.name: get_balance_sheets
tool_schemas.description: Get balance sheets for a company. Args: ticker: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL) period: Period of the balance sheet (e.g. annual, quarterly, ttm) limit: Number of balance sheets to return (default: 4)

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

limit.description: Number of balance sheets to return (default: 4).

tool_schemas.name: get_cash_flow_statements
tool_schemas.description: Get cash flow statements for a company. Args: ticker: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL) period: Period of the cash flow statement (e.g. annual, quarterly, ttm) limit: Number of cash flow statements to return (default: 4)

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

period.description: Period of the cash flow statement.

limit.description: Number of cash flow statements to return (default: 4).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_stock_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest available quote/price for the requested equity ticker, including the most recent timestamp the backend has for that instrument. This endpoint returns a single object (no paging). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid ticker, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved or no latest price is available, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if access is not permitted or you exceed rate/usage limits.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_stock_prices
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical OHLCV-style price bars for the requested equity ticker between `start_date` and `end_date` (inclusive) at the requested `interval` and `interval_multiplier`. Results are returned as a time-ordered list of bars; this endpoint does not expose a cursor—reduce the date range to retrieve data in multiple calls. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dates are not in YYYY-MM-DD format, if `start_date` > `end_date`, if `interval_multiplier` < 1, or if `interval` is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved or no bars exist in the requested range, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for authentication or usage-limit failures.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

start_date.description: Start date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

interval_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the interval (e.g. 1 for 1-day, 2 for 2-day).

tool_schemas.name: get_company_news
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent news items associated with the requested equity ticker, up to `limit` items when provided. Results are returned as a list ordered from most recent to oldest; you can paginate by lowering the `limit` and narrowing your subsequent requests by time using the items’ published timestamps (no cursor is provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid ticker or `limit` < 1, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved or no news is available for the instrument, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you are not authorized or exceed your plan limits.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL).

limit.description: Maximum number of news items to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_available_crypto_tickers
tool_schemas.description: Lists the crypto tickers/pairs supported by this backend for price lookup. Results are returned as a single list (no paging). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed request limits.

tool_schemas.name: get_crypto_prices
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical price bars for the requested crypto ticker between `start_date` and `end_date` (inclusive) at the requested `interval` and `interval_multiplier`. Results are returned as a time-ordered list of bars; this endpoint does not provide cursor-based pagination, so request smaller date ranges to page through large histories. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid date formats, `start_date` > `end_date`, unsupported `interval`, or `interval_multiplier` < 1, NOT_FOUND if the crypto ticker is not supported or no data exists for the requested window, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for auth or usage-limit violations.

ticker.description: Crypto ticker symbol/pair to fetch prices for (as supported by the backend).

start_date.description: Start date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

interval_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the interval (e.g. 1 for 1-hour, 2 for 2-hour).

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_crypto_prices
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical price bars for the requested crypto ticker between `start_date` and `end_date` (inclusive) at the requested `interval`. Results are returned as a time-ordered list of bars without cursor-based pagination; page by splitting the time range into multiple requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid date formats, `start_date` > `end_date`, or unsupported `interval`, NOT_FOUND if the ticker is not supported or no bars exist in the requested range, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if authentication fails or you exceed rate/usage limits.

ticker.description: Crypto ticker symbol to query (e.g., BTC-USD).

start_date.description: Start date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date (inclusive) for price data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

interval.description: Time interval/granularity of returned price bars.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_crypto_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest available price/quote for the requested crypto ticker/pair, including the most recent timestamp available. This endpoint returns a single object (no paging). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid ticker, NOT_FOUND if the ticker is not supported or no latest price is available, and UNAUTHORIZED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for authentication or quota enforcement failures.

ticker.description: Crypto ticker symbol to query (e.g., BTC-USD).

tool_schemas.name: get_sec_filings
tool_schemas.description: Get all SEC filings for a company. Args: ticker: Ticker symbol of the company (e.g. AAPL, GOOGL) limit: Number of SEC filings to return (default: 10) filing_type: Type of SEC filing (e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K)

ticker.description: Company equity ticker symbol to query (e.g., AAPL).

limit.description: Maximum number of SEC filings to return (default: 10).

filing_type.description: Filter results to a specific SEC filing type (e.g., 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K).

tool_schemas.name: list_instruments
tool_schemas.description: Lists instruments with optional filters. Results are returned as a paginated list ordered by `ticker` asc. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed your plan limits.

exchange.description: Filter by exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ, NYSE).

ticker_prefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix match on ticker (e.g. 'AA' matches AAPL, AAL).

limit.description: Maximum number of instruments to return (default: 100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single instrument by its `id`. Returns the instrument object. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such instrument exists, UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed your plan limits.

tool_schemas.name: resolve_ticker
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a requested `ticker` to a single active instrument, applying case-insensitive lookup by upper-casing the input. Returns the resolved instrument. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid ticker and NOT_FOUND if no active instrument exists for the ticker.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol or crypto pair to resolve (case-insensitive).

asset_class.description: Optional asset class constraint to disambiguate ticker symbols.

tool_schemas.name: update_instrument_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the lifecycle status of an instrument. This endpoint enforces the allowed transitions: `active` -> `inactive`/`delisted`, `inactive` -> `active`/`delisted`, `delisted` -> (no transitions). Returns the updated instrument. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instrument does not exist, CONFLICT if the transition is not allowed, UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed your plan limits.
